paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Ablation studies between Consistency-Bi and Consistency-Uni on test set of IWSLT14 De-En task of wait-k policy.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for three different consistency metrics. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 8, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and uses a linear scale ranging from 20 to 32. A purple line with circular markers and a dashed line style represents "Consistency-CE," beginning at a value of 20 at AL=1 and increasing to a value of 29.5 at AL=8. A green line with square markers and a dashed line style represents "Consistency-Uni," starting at a value of 25.5 at AL=1 and rising to a value of 31 at AL=8. A red line with triangular markers and a solid line style represents "Consistency-Bi," commencing at a value of 26.5 at AL=1 and increasing to a value of 31.5 at AL=8.
